messages.content: Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 with product_id p_sony_xm5_blk is in stock, and if it is, look for similar audio alternatives in the audio category and pick the best option for quantity 1. Turn that into a cart item, apply the SAVE15 coupon code, prepare checkout with my credit_card, and place the order for user_id user_123. Then add the best recommendation for the black XM5 to my cart, format those cart details into a message, and generate an invoice for invoice_items [{ product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1 }] using the best available discount and send it to user@example.com through stripe. Also check my living room AC with device_id ac_living, see its status, and set it to eco mode at 22°C. After that, send Alex an app alert on the app channel with the formatted cart message.
